gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-noisy-service: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-noisy-service: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-noisy-service: The page says stealing can't fix this because a thief takes only a queued task and a started leaf can't be split, so uneven work needs leaves small enough to spread the expensive rows over many of them (option a).
recorded.prompt:q-big-scan: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-big-scan: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-big-scan: The page says a range of one item can't split, so to - from == 1 must also be a leaf, and that a split whose left half is the whole range again makes the task fork itself until the stack overflows (option c).
recorded.prompt:q-crawler-chunks: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-crawler-chunks: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-crawler-chunks: The page shows that peeling 8 million items threw a StackOverflowError because compute() on the rest adds a stack frame per chunk (option c).
recorded.prompt:q-twenty-eighty: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-twenty-eighty: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-twenty-eighty: The page shows a 10/90 split went 86 levels deep with 48,531 tasks against 13 and 16,383 for 50/50, and says that on even work an uneven ratio costs tasks (option c).

recorded.prompt:q-noisy-service:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-noisy-service:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-noisy-service:b: The page shows four leaves per worker put the options in two leaves and took 567 ms, against 163 ms at 64 per worker.
recorded.prompt:q-noisy-service:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-noisy-service:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-noisy-service:c: The page says a started leaf is a plain loop on one thread that nothing can take half of, so extra workers can't share it.
recorded.prompt:q-noisy-service:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-noisy-service:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-noisy-service:d: The page says 'Stealing can't fix this. A thief takes only a queued task.'
recorded.prompt:q-big-scan:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-big-scan:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-big-scan:a: The page names the to - from == 1 check as what makes a single item a leaf, so a test on the budget alone does not stop on one item that costs more than the budget.
recorded.prompt:q-big-scan:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-big-scan:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-big-scan:b: The page says a range of one item can't split, and its splitPoint cuts between indices, never inside an item.
recorded.prompt:q-big-scan:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-big-scan:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-big-scan:d: The page's code cuts only at splitPoint, which uses the prefix sums of steps, and has no fallback to a middle index.
recorded.prompt:q-crawler-chunks:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-crawler-chunks:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-crawler-chunks:a: The page shows peeling was fast on the test file but overflowed the stack at 7,999 frames on the large file, while halving finished in 73 ms.
recorded.prompt:q-crawler-chunks:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-crawler-chunks:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-crawler-chunks:b: The page says other workers steal the chunks as they are forked, with 405 steals on the test file.
recorded.prompt:q-crawler-chunks:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-crawler-chunks:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-crawler-chunks:d: The page shows the peel failed with StackOverflowError and that forked chunks were stolen as they came, not that a queue rejected them.
recorded.prompt:q-twenty-eighty:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-twenty-eighty:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-twenty-eighty:a: The page's 10/90 run made more tasks and a deeper tree than halving, not fewer.
recorded.prompt:q-twenty-eighty:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-twenty-eighty:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-twenty-eighty:b: The page's 10/90 run took 47 ms against 53 ms for halving and says the time doesn't show the cost.
recorded.prompt:q-twenty-eighty:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-twenty-eighty:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-twenty-eighty:d: The page shows the ratio changed both the task count (48,531 against 16,383) and the depth (86 against 13) at the same threshold of 1,000.
